title: Slip Coding.pdf — page 10
text:
Coinsurance
What is it?
– Practice of an insurer participating in only a 
percentage part of a whole policy (e.g. 75%) 
Remainder may be covered by other 
insurers or by insured 
Structure
– Coinsurance operates on a 
proportional (vertical) as opposed to a 
first loss/excess (horizontal) basis
– In RiskLink it is defined by a 
combination of ‘blanket limit’ and ‘part 
of’ fields 
When in doubt, draw a diagram!
